notes.title: Hotfix on August 26th
notes.content:
Hello to the Taimanin fans out there,

We will be installing a hotfix shortly after this announcement, as follows:


[b]VOLUME[/b]
The volume settings for Bridge Race will be fixed. Now it will follow the volume settings correctly.

[b]TEXT MESSAGES[/b]
The popup message for reducing Game Points will be displayed correctly in several languages.


Stay tuned!

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Upcoming Maintenance on August 21st
notes.content:
Hi Taimanin fans out there,

We are planning maintenance starting at 08:00 UTC, August 21st. The maintenance should take about an hour. You won't be able to play the game during the maintenance. 


Here are the key issues we are addressing during this maintenance: 

[b]VISUAL UPDATE[/b] 
New images will be updated on the Steam Store page: images, game icons, and the title screen. 

[b]NEW CARDS[/b] 
New cards will be added to the roster. 

[b]NEW GAME: BRIDGE RACE[/b] 
Avoid obstacles and get to the goal! Collect gold coins! 

[b]NEW GAME: JIGSAW PUZZLE[/b] 
Enjoy new puzzles made out of Taimanin Collection cards! 
You can change the difficulty before starting the game: EASY, NORMAL, and HARD. 

Solve the puzzle faster than the threshold for each difficulty to earn bonus Game Points: 
- EASY: 01:20
- NORMAL: : 04:00 
- HARD: 10:00

[b]NEW FEATURE: REDUCE GAME POINTS[/b] 
You can now use Red Gems to reduce 500 Game Points you collected during the day. This will allow you to make room for more Game Points, without waiting to reset.


Stay tuned!

notes.title: [IMPORTANT] Upcoming Maintenance on July 23rd
notes.content:
Hi Taimanin fans out there,

We are planning maintenance starting at 01:30 UTC, July 23rd. The maintenance should take about an hour. You won't be able to play the game during the maintenance.

Here are the key issues we are addressing during this maintenance:

[i][b]NEW CARDS[/b][/i]
New cards will be added to the roster. (Self-explanatory.)

[i][b]ADDITIONAL LANGUAGE SUPPORTS[/b][/i]
We will support three additional languages, as follows: German, Russian, and Portuguese.

[i][b]GAME FIXES[/b][/i]
When you quit the game early (by pressing Esc), you will receive game results as normal based on the final score, and you will be able to receive Game Points and EXPs accordingly.

We also did some proofreadings on some in-game texts.


Stay tuned!
